name: security-guidance
description: Security review for agent-generated code: regex pattern warnings on every edit, a vulnerability rubric applied to the session diff before finishing, and a deep agentic commit review across OWASP vulnerability classes (injection, XSS, SSRF, secrets, IDOR, auth bypass, deserialization, path traversal).
author: David Dworken / Anthropic (ported to Kimi Code by mnshkv)
license: Apache-2.0 (upstream patterns, rubric, and review prompts); port © mnshkv

interface.shortDescription: Pattern warnings on edits, diff review per turn, agentic OWASP commit review
interface.longDescription:
Guides your coding agent toward writing more secure code, in three layers.

1. Pattern warnings — on every file edit or write, the agent checks the changed content against ~25 known-dangerous patterns (yaml.load without SafeLoader, pickle/torch.load on untrusted data, raw innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, os.system, subprocess shell=True, disabled TLS verification, hardcoded crypto mistakes, GitHub Actions workflow injection, and more) using the regex database in references/ and applies the attached remediation guidance before continuing.

2. Diff review — before finishing a turn, the agent reviews the session's git diff against a detailed vulnerability rubric covering command injection, path traversal, SQL injection, IDOR/authorization, SSRF, XSS, secrets in logs, unsafe deserialization, TLS misconfiguration, OAuth flow weaknesses, argument injection, and more — flagging only newly introduced (+ line) issues with severity and a concrete fix.

3. Agentic commit review — before committing, the agent performs a deep review: reads every changed file in full, greps for callers and data flows across the repository, checks high-miss patterns (gate/action field mismatch, allowlist semantic escape, fail-open state drift), then adversarially self-refutes each candidate finding before reporting what survives.

Org-specific policies: drop a security-guidance.md in your project or user config directory to add checks (see skills/security-guidance/references/custom-rules.md).

Ported from the Claude Code plugin 'security-guidance' (David Dworken / Anthropic, Apache-2.0). The original runs as PreToolUse/Stop hooks plus an inner Claude Agent SDK reviewer; Kimi Code has no hook API, so this port turns the same checks into instructions the agent applies itself.
